# `txt`

Helper: `txt(text, o)`, `sm lbl strong eyebrow kv`  
Kit (`src/ui`): text element · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaText` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Inline text with size, tone, weight; parts can carry flags (bold, small, uppercase, soft, danger, success, warning, link, heading).

## Variants

- `sm` (small ink-soft), `lbl` (label ink-soft), `strong`, `eyebrow`, `kv` (bold label then value)

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

ink, ink-soft, heading, link, success, warning, danger, info, text scale

## Do

- Use the helper that names the role (`sm`, `lbl`)

## Don't

- Do not pass a colour or a pixel size; use `tone` and `size`

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Newlines are kept (pre-line).

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Inline. See helper reference
